title: The dashboard shows the served Graphyard commit in its bottom-left corner and follows a deploy
description: A real browser at 1280 px and at 390 px signs in to a real control plane serving the built dashboard. On the Work page and on the Master page, with its terminal live, a label in the viewport's bottom-left corner shows the short commit /api/status reports, clear of every control and of the terminal. The plane then restarts at a new commit, and the label shows the new commit on the page's next poll, with no reload.

steps.name: read the version label on Work and Master across a restart at a new commit
